environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate task in isolated subnet (no NAT, no IGW) within VPC vpc-0a3f8e2c. Accessible exclusively through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0b4d7a91e3f2c8a56 interface endpoint. The VPC endpoint policy restricts principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/DocProcessorClient and conditions on aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4. Endpoint security group (sg-0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8) permits inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.200.16.0/28 (the processing lambda subnet). No internet-facing load balancer exists; the internal NLB target group is registered only with the PrivateLink endpoint service. DNS is configured via Route53 private hosted zone associated with the consumer VPC only. Additionally, the Fargate task role has no S3 or external network permissions, and the task ENI has no public IP assignment. The container runs as uid 65534 (nobody) with a read-only root filesystem except /var/data/uploads which is an ephemeral EFS mount scoped to the task.

config.network: isolated subnet, no IGW, no NAT gateway
